answers.question: Are my conversations used for model training by default?
answers.answer: No, your prompts, responses, and file contents are not used to train foundation models. Microsoft may use optional customer feedback to improve Copilot, but not to train foundation models.

citations.title: Microsoft Copilot for individuals: your activity history | Microsoft Support

answers.question: How long are my conversations kept?
answers.answer: For the older Copilot experience, conversation activity is normally saved for 18 months. The policy pages we checked don't clearly say how long conversations are kept for the updated Copilot experience.

citations.title: Privacy FAQ for Microsoft Copilot (older experience)

answers.question: How can I stop my conversations being used for training?
answers.answer: The policy pages we checked don't clearly say.

answers.question: How can I delete my conversations?
answers.answer: To delete individual conversations, open Copilot signed in, select the conversation from the Chats list on the left, click the More menu (...) next to the chat, and select Delete. To delete your entire chat history, you can manage it through the privacy dashboard.

citations.title: Microsoft Copilot for individuals: your privacy controls and choices | Microsoft Support
